new.name: Handwritten overwrite turns a typed identifier into a different valid-looking one
new.page_shows: Typed 'GH-003-2018' with a handwritten scribble over the final digits, and 'Round 3' with a handwritten 3 written over the typed 3; the cc line below reads GH-003-2018
new.output_says: Hearing Order GH-003-2013NOVA Gas Transmission Ltd. ... submit Round Information Requests
new.why_it_matters: The hearing order number is the key a filing is indexed and cited by; it now reads as a different, real-looking hearing (2013), run into the next word, and the round number is gone. Nothing flags it, and the cc line contradicts it.
new.lesson: Cross-check identifiers inside a document (subject vs cc line vs metadata) and flag disagreements; filers should not overwrite typed text by hand.
